answer: Delta ladder blocks bulk fakes: each identity posts a bond; the k-th from one controller pays 45 plus a delta of 7 per earlier rung. Each epoch a random raven audits rungs, linking shared-funding wallets so ladder-splitting fails. A zephyr ping is the check: the holder answers with a fresh signature in an hour or the bond burns. 1,000 fake identities cost 3,541,500 against a 40,000 pool. One honest identity pays 45 once, keeping its full share.
